heading: The experiences
that shaped me
intro: From independent projects to products used by millions, each role has changed how I think, collaborate, and design.

items.text: Managed construction and interior design projects during my military service.
Founded a boutique UX/UI studio creating intuitive digital products.
Managed projects and contractors across architecture and interior design.
Designed product experiences focused on clear and engaging user flows.
Designed intuitive product experiences across digital consumer products.
